messages:
mike_p: Quick alignment — partner region cutover Thu 09:00 PT. I'm building a tight go/no-go checklist here. Post short status updates only. @sarah_r you good on consumer side?

sarah_r: Yes. Consumer switched to prod topic and new group `marketplace-prod-1`. Smoke consumer is ready.

olivia_t: SI side: entitlement toggle applied in staging. Need partner to send 3 test events with SKU=test-sku-xyz and invoice_id=go_live_2658 so we can validate mapping+signature.

juan_g: HW partner will send tests at T-30m, T-10m, and at cutover. We'll do signature rotate at T-15m and publish pubkey to s3://partner-keys/2658002468.pub.

kate_ops: Monitoring prep done. Dashboard "marketplace-cutover-2658" created. Alerts: ingestion-lag > 60s, failed-signature rate > 1/min. PD rotation: kate_ops -> olivia_t.

mike_p: Checklist I'm tracking here (short):
1) sku mapping deployed
2) entitlement mapping validated
3) smoke events accepted and verified
4) signature verification OK
5) first reconciliation job scheduled (+2h)
Tick items as you go.

sarah_r: sku mapping deployed — ran quick sanity: `select count(*) from sku_map where partner_sku='test-sku-xyz' and rwd_plan is not null;` -> 1. No mismatches.

olivia_t: entitlement mapping validated: sampled 500 rows, found 2 mismatches; fixed mapping in partner mapping table, re-run -> clean.

juan_g: Sent 1st test at 08:30PT. Received on our side, signature verified. Will resend at 08:50 and 09:00.

onboard-bot: ingest-smoke: received 3/3 events. median latency 120ms. signature_checks: OK. payload-sample:
```
{
  "partner_sku": "test-sku-xyz",
  "invoice_id": "go_live_2658",
  "units": 5,
  "timestamp": "2026-03-21T08:30:00Z"
}
```

kate_ops: Ops playbook update: keep 48h replay window for late arrivals. Auto-credit policy: if mismatch rate > 0.25% in first 24h, queue auto-credit job. Added note to docs: https://rwd.internal/docs/marketplace/cutover-playbook

mike_p: Reconciliation cadence? Recommend first run at +2h, then hourly for 24h.

sarah_r: Confirmed. Job scheduled: `rwd-recon --start 2658002468 --first-delay 2h --interval 1h` (placeholder command).

juan_g: One partner ask: they'll rotate keys tomorrow morning (post-cutover). Can we accept thumbprint rollover header?

olivia_t: Consumer code already accepts `X-Key-Id` header and keeps previous key valid for 30 minutes after rotation. Verified in staging.

mike_p: Final: @kate_ops you'll post GO at T-5 if nothing flagged?

kate_ops: Yes. I'll post GO at T-5 unless someone objects. Abort instruction: call immediate abort in thread + @oncall. :thumbsup: 

mike_p: Thanks everyone — I'll archive after cutover with final notes. Good luck!
